title: rhus copallinum subsp. leucantha
intro: Rhus copallinum subsp. leucantha, commonly known as Smooth Sumac, is a species of shrub or small tree in the Anacardiaceae family, native to North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of fever and cough. The therapeutic actions of Smooth Sumac include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Smooth Sumac may help to protect against oxidative stress and modulate the immune system.
